title: Ensure 'Turn off Microsoft Defender AntiVirus' is set to 'Disabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Turn off Microsoft Defender Antivirus to 'Disabled'
reason: Turning off Microsoft Defender Antivirus exposes the system to malware and other unwanted software. It must be explicitly set to Disabled so the service remains active.

title: Ensure 'Turn on e-mail scanning' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Scan\Turn on e-mail scanning to 'Enabled'
reason: Enabling this feature allows the antivirus engine to parse and scan emails and their attachments as they arrive, providing an early layer of defense against phishing and malicious payloads.

title: Ensure 'Scan all downloaded files and attachments' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\Windows Components\Microsoft Defender Antivirus\Real-time Protection\Scan all downloaded files and attachments to 'Enabled'
reason: This policy ensures that IOAV (Attachment Services) protection is active, which inspects files downloaded from browsers or saved from email clients.
